card.name: Words before an emphatic adverb or adjective
card.fires_on: Ordinary words in casual web prose (blogs, forum posts) where the next word could be an emphatic or informal intensifier like 'literally', 'basically' or 'actual'. The marked word is varied: 'every', 'caution', 'child', 'high', 'now'.

modes.label: Before an adverb slot
modes.description: A verb phrase or noun in chatty writing, where an emphatic adverb could come next.
modes.example: I’m going to actually start flossing<< every>> day”.

modes.label: Informal opinion or exclamation
modes.description: A word ending a casual remark or warning in a blog or comment.
modes.example: Proceed with<< caution>>! I could imagine it being a way

card.writes: It pushes up emphatic words like 'literally', 'basically' and 'actual', and pushes down slangy tweak words like 'tweaked', 'skinny' and 'gee'.
card.plain: It fires on casual blog-style words where an emphasis word like 'literally' or 'actually' might come next.
